title: The right side is used when the left side is not NULL.

origin.description: This infix operator is the conceptual opposite of %||%, providing a fallback only if x is defined.

arguments.name: x, y
arguments.description: If x is NULL, will return x; otherwise returns y.

origin.details: This infix operator is the conceptual opposite of %||%, providing a fallback only if x is defined.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.

translation.description: The right side is used when the left side is not None.

arguments.name: left, right
arguments.description: If left is None, returns left; otherwise returns right.

translation.details: The right side is used when the left side is not None.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
from rlang.null_and import null_and
left = null_and(1, 2)
right = null_and(None, 2)
print(f"{left} {'NULL' if right is None else right}")
